HALLOWEEN EVENT BATTLE\nDefeat Neewollah!!
So the intruders are still in my manor.\nWhat do you want?
You're the one that stole a part of Olant and\nPotumkin, aren't you?
I'm Neewollah, the owner of this manor. Those\ncreatures broke into my manor and interrupted my\nsleep...What's so wrong with punishing them?
I-I know, but...\nThey're just kids, you should come them some\nslack...
By the way, you guys were doing pretty well\nfighting against my minions in my manor...
So let's make a bet. If you could win against me,\nI'll return their body parts. but if you lose...
W-what if we lose?
I'll get a part of your body too...\nEspecially that little one looks delicious...!
Y-you've got to be kidding me!!\nLike I would ever let you take a bite of me!!
Jeez! Well, let's find the parts of Olant and\nPotumkin that this thing stole!
Oh my goshhh?!
Treat or Trick!!
Treat or Trick!
We'll prank you if you don't give us sweets, pom!
Grandpa! Well done!
The prank was super successful!!
W-what is this? Don't tell me you know each other?
What the heck...\nSo you fooled us right from the beginning!
That's because we haven't got sweets from the\nlittle guest.
Oh, by the way we've got sweets from the big\nguest.
The big one gave us sweets too this time, pom!
What?! When did that happen?!\nMore importantly, why did the adventurer get\npranked with me too then?!
We simply thought it might be nice to prank the\nadventurer as well!
Yeah, it was too much trouble if we had to\nseparate you just for the prank.
That is such a stupid reason!!
Well, well.\nFather and mother also know about this.
It was fun for me too. My grandchildren haven't\nasked me to do something for them in a while.
Neewollah, you were so cool, you know!
Our grandpa never disappoints us!
That last act was legit, pom!
Oh, you're here.\nI've also heard from Zarth and Zoe that you're a\nmighty one. Well, please show me what you've got!
I've never seen that kind of fighting style\nbefore....It's new to me.\nGotta live longer to learn more!
Difficulty: Hard has been added to\nBOSS: Neewollah.
Difficulty: Very Hard has been added to\nBOSS: Neewollah.
Oh, you came at the right time!
Zoe made us sweets as our rewards this time and\nshe said that she wanted to make some for\nNeewollah too...
If we secretly prepare the ingredients for her, I\nthink she'll be happy. So, I'd like to ask for\nyour help to collect them...
What? Me..? There's no way we can do it without\ngetting busted. That's why I need your help.\nCome on, I beg you!
Okay!
I'm kinda busy!
Thanks! I knew you would say yes!\nOkay, here's the memo of the ingredients you\nneed to collect!
What? Really? Even after I begged you like that?!\nWell then, I should do this to someone like you.\nTrick or...
Alright, forget it then. Jeila and Zoe will get\nmad at me if they know I force you...But if you\nchange your mind later, please help me!
How is it? Is it going well?
Well, I guess I should be more understanding since\nI asked you to collect them secretly...\nAlright, go on then!
Wow! You've got them!\nI'm sure Zoe will be happy!\nWell, here's your reward!
Not enough [ffff64]sweets[ffffff] that Jacky wants...

Oh, it's you!\nThere's something I wanna discuss with you.
Zarth and Zoe are planning to prepare something to\nwelcome Neewollah, but...
Some of the ingredients to make his favorite\nsweets seem to be difficult to get.
We wanna go find the ingredients, but I think Zoe\nwill be worried...So, I want you to collect them\nsecretly for us!
Okay!
I'm busy now!
That's great! Thanks!
Okay, please collect the ingredients written here\nthen! Since it's you, it's prolly gonna be a piece\nof cake!
T-that's too bad...\nBut we still got time. If you change your mind,\nplease help me.
Hmm, seems to me that you'll need some more time.\nBut since I told you to do it secretly, it can't\nbe helped. It's okay, I'll wait!
Have you really got them?\nThat's awesome! Thanks!
Zarth and Zoe will be happy for sure!\nHere's your reward, take it!

Oh! You're here, pom!\nHow are you, pom?\nYou look great this time, pom!
Oh right, it seems that Zarth and Zoe are planning\nto prepare a feast for Neewollah later, pom.
But they said it's been a while since they\nprepared a feast for him and they were not sure if\nthey could have all the ingredients ready, pom...
I think having more ingredients than enough is not\na bad idea, pom! So just in case, I want you to\nhelp find them, pom!
Okay!
I don't think I can now...
Thank, pom!\nI knew you would say yes, pom!
Alright, the ingredients I want you to collect are\nwritten here, pom. Oh right, please do it secretly\nif possible, pom!
I wanna surprise them by suddenly bringing the\ningredients to them, pom!
I-I see, pom...\nI asked you because I trust you the most, pom...\nIt's ok, let me know if you change your mind, pom!
Have you collected the ingredients, pom? Oh, okay,\nplease go on. And remember to do it secretly, pom!
Pom! You've collected all of them, pom!\nNobody noticed what you were doing, right, pom?
I can surprise Zarth and Zoe with this now, pom.\nYou must be tired now, pom.\nHere, take your reward, pom!
